_doc: PROJECTIONS for the Fable-takedown scene — the 3 short/medium/long 'guesses' (the anticipation build-up). These are CONJECTURE, NOT measurement. They live OUTSIDE the substrate (compiled/ holds only measured facts) and are rendered as fuzzy forward-arcs, clearly marked PROJECTION. Authored from candidates/dial_engine/experiments/fable_event/CONJECTURE_trajectory.md (parent C0 + children K1-K5 + rivals R1-R4). Likelihood bands are QUALITATIVE and conjectural — never a measured probability, never a bit. Frame-relative valence: 'good/bad' is observer-indexed (national wrapper). Re-scan at horizons; demote-not-kill; dead-children tally is the honest gauge.
parent_conjecture: C0 — the takedown is a trajectory-altering precedent: frontier-AI access shifts from a roughly-open market toward state-controlled, nationality-gated supply.

projections.modal_guess: Near-term squeeze on Anthropic and foreign developers continues — revenue/reach drag, IPO-timing pressure, developer migration, ecosystem uncertainty.
projections.likelihood_basis: ALREADY VISIBLE at t0 — the squeeze is not a forecast so much as an extrapolation of live beats.
also_live: R1 one-off (rapid reversal — Anthropic is 'working to restore', dispute pressure is real)
projections.falsifier: Fable/Mythos access fully restored within 30 days (by 2026-07-12) AND no Anthropic public-sector or enterprise revenue-guidance reduction attributable to the event AND no sustained (>2 trading-day) >2% move in the named enterprise stocks (Workday/Oracle/Palantir) attributable to it, all observed by 2026-09-13.

projections.modal_guess: The mechanism normalizes / generalizes — nationality-gated frontier-model access becomes a standing tool (EO sequels, BIS/Commerce actions, KYC-by-nationality), and/or a second US lab's deployed model draws a comparable restriction; the governance discourse cites this as a turning point.
projections.likelihood_basis: Seeded by the June-2 EO + existing chip export-controls; but no 2nd case yet and reversal pressure is live.
also_live: R1 one-off (stays a single legal event)
R4 decentralization (demand routes to open-weight/local, not to a state)
projections.falsifier: NO non-Anthropic deployed frontier model named in a US Commerce/BIS export-control or nationality-gating action by 2027-06-13 AND no new EO/BIS rule conditioning frontier-model API access on user nationality in that window.

projections.modal_guess: Contested. Pav's bet: a measurable rest-of-world shift toward Chinese frontier models where US models become unavailable to foreign nationals (relative China advantage). Heavily confounded; rivals strongly in play.
projections.conjecture_child: K3 (China relative advantage — Pav's directional bet)
projections.likelihood_basis: No direct t0 evidence yet; the disclosed_null 'no foreign-gov reaction found' is exactly the fuzzy region a scout must sharpen before this can move.
projections.falsifier: rest-of-world usage/API share of Chinese frontier models (vs US frontier models) does NOT rise by >5 percentage points over 24 months (by 2028-06-13) on a named public proxy (e.g. OpenRouter model-usage rankings or an equivalent aggregator), OR China's own compute/export constraints demonstrably neutralize any gap.
